svg.title: NeoDEM network architecture
svg.desc: Operators reach a Kubernetes ingress over HTTPS. The server on port 3001 connects to Postgres 5432, NATS 4222 and RustFS 9000, and dials each robot-agent on 41243. Teleop sockets go from the browser straight to the agent and are bound to a control lease. The robot-agent reaches its sidecar on 8767 and the G1 over DDS domain 0. vla-server on 8000 and polling workers run on a GPU box. Egress to Gemini and Hugging Face uses 443. Open this file in a browser and click a box to see only its links. Hover a line for details.

g.title: Operators reach the cluster over HTTPS through the ingress. In dev, vite on :1420 proxies /api and WS to :3001
The ingress sends / to the app
Combined ingress (values-local): /api, /.well-known and /health go straight to the server
App-only ingress (values-production): the app nginx proxies /api, WS included, to API_UPSTREAM
Quest 3 loads the app over USB adb reverse. WebXR accepts only the localhost origin
Teleop straight to the agent: keyboard, gamepad and VR on WS :41243/ws/keyboard-teleop, bound to a control lease with {bind:{leaseId,generation}}. roboctl uses REST /api/v1 on the same port
g.text: direct to robot, skips the server

g.title: Server to agent on :41243: pull registration (/api/v1/register + agent card), health every 30 s, safety heartbeat every 5 s, task push, recording start/stop, A2A JSON-RPC at /, control-lease install/renew/release (Bearer AGENT_MEMORY_TOKEN)
The server dials /ws/telemetry/:robotId per robot, about every 2 s, and rebroadcasts on /api/a2a/ws
Agent to server on :3001 with Bearer NEODEM_SERVICE_TOKEN: compliance logs, Agent Mode events, fleet peers, incidents, eval episodes
Prisma over DATABASE_URL. Local dev uses a SQLite file instead
NATS JetStream (optional): jobs.training.>, jobs.dataset.>, synthetic.jobs.>, plus KV
RustFS S3 (optional): 8 buckets for datasets, checkpoints, models, logs, scans, twins, clips and patrol photos
Workers poll /api/training/workers/* and /api/twin/workers/* with Bearer WORKER_API_TOKEN
The training worker reads datasets and writes checkpoints through S3
Server egress on 443: Gemini or OpenRouter for NL commands, HF Hub for dataset import
Agent egress on 443: Genkit to Gemini or OpenRouter
HARDWARE_SIDECAR_URL: /health /state /action /estop /cameras/* /pointcloud/* /record/* /loco/*
G1 EDU sim profiles point HARDWARE_SIDECAR_URL at the sim facade, which serves the same contract
Agent Mode narration: POST /say. The server relays /voices and volume
Read-only lowstate, hands, battery and odometry from the subscribe-only bridge on PC2
The bridge subscribes to rt/lowstate, rt/dex3/*/state, rt/lf/bmsstate and rt/odommodestate
Loco RPC on rt/api/sport/*, odometry and LiDAR over DDS domain 0. Head cameras over teleimager ZMQ :60000 or TCP :5600
VLA_SERVER_URL: /predict in the closed loop, /reset, /config, /load-adapter for LoRA hot-swap. No gRPC in use
GR00T backend over ZMQ :5555
Agent Mode planner and VLM over the OpenAI-compatible /v1 and native /api/chat. The server uses it too when LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
Node, Express, Prisma. REST /api, one WS at /api/a2a/ws, /metrics for Prometheus (no auth), A2A card at /.well-known/a2a
One per robot. A2A at /, REST /api/v1, WS /ws/telemetry, /ws/pointcloud, /ws/keyboard-teleop, /ws/bilateral-teleop, /ws/agent-mode
DDS ↔ HTTP bridge. Read-only by default (G1_READ_ONLY=1); /loco/* is gated by G1_LOCO_ENABLED
MuJoCo G1 that speaks the real Unitree DDS protocol on domain 1 over loopback. HTTP facade on :8777
Real robot on DDS domain 0. Microphone on multicast 239.168.123.161:5555
Separate repo. SmolVLA, pi0.5, GR00T, LingBot and others behind one HTTP API

svg.text: Arrows point away from the side that opens the connection. Dashed: optional or per profile. Green dashed: direct to robot. Violet: simulation. Opened directly, click a box to focus it.
